identity_model_decision.decision: DEFER the additive identity model; document the 7 branch/non-Title-IV programmes as IDENTITY_NOT_REPRESENTABLE_SAFELY residuals.
identity_model_decision.recommended_model: nullable federal_unitid + internal athletics_entity_id (stable) + parent_unitid + campus_label + provenance; coverage keys on athletics_entity_id falling back to federal_unitid.
identity_model_decision.rationale: Preserves federal-UNITID semantics, no fabricated identifiers, no broad migration this phase (would touch reconcile, coverage keying, athletics_domains, matching). Implement in a dedicated phase only if a future division needs it to close identity cases.
